# hi-scout: hướng dẫn

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Thu thập bằng chứng có truy vết từ code, tài liệu dự án và nguồn ngoài (web docs, GitHub, ảnh/UI); có mode tuần tự và song song.

**Mô tả gốc (EN):** Gather traceable evidence from repository code, project documents, and external sources. Use for codebase exploration, architecture, feature tracing, dependency or impact analysis, file discovery, web/docs lookup, GitHub repo analysis, and image or UI understanding.

## Cách gọi

```text
/hi-scout <question | symbol | path | SQL | impact target | repo URL | docs topic | image> [--code|--doc|--ask|--deep|--impact] [--external] [--parallel]
```

## Ranh giới

- Retrieve and verify context; do not own planning, diagnosis, or implementation decisions.
- Never fabricate missing context.
- Spawn only when a mode requests it, never more than 5 units.
